leaves.name: r16CoreY
leaves.doc: r16-split: R16_EichlerShimuraJ1' with its rank-two clause deleted (a consequence of r16; R16Split.coreY_of_r16). For a newform f in S_2(Gamma_1(N)) with nebentypus chi and J = J_1(N): [K_f:Q] < infinity, and one Q-quotient pi : J ->> A with theta : K_f -> End^0(A), dim A = [K_f:Q], and arithmetic Frobenius at p not dividing N*l acting on every iota-component of V_l(A) with trace iota(a_p) and determinant iota(chi(p)) p. The rank-two clause is proved from dim A = [K_f:Q], mumfordTorsionAlgClosed and charPolyIndepOfEllAlgClosed (Mumford 19 Thm 4): R16Split.r16_of_printed. Still a composite of two printed theorems about Shimura's A_f, which has no Lean definition (no Hecke correspondences on X_1(N), no S_2 <-> H^0(X_1(N), Omega^1) comparison).
leaves.source: Shimura 1973 Thm 1, unconditional clauses (A_f, K_f-action, dim A_f = [K_f:Q]; audit row R16); Diamond-Shurman Thm 9.5.4 / Shimura 1971 Thm 7.11 (char. poly. of Frobenius on V_l(A_f), from the congruence relation Shimura 1971 Thm 7.9); numbers UNVERIFIED. The rank-two source (Shimura 1971 7.4, Ribet 1977) is no longer needed (r16-split)
